title: Aurora Solar API
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://docs.aurorasolar.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

The Aurora API lets you build apps and integrations with the Aurora platform. Our APIs enable your organization to scale by creating efficient and seamless workflows, minimizing data loss, mistakes, and time to make manual data transfers. With the API you can, for example:

- Create, retrieve, and update projects
- Create, retrieve, and accept design requests
- Create and retrieve design details including simulation outputs
- Retrieve design assets, pricing, financings, and agreements
- Triggering a post-sales workflow in your IT ecosystem on homeowner's e-signing the agreement

For an overview of how Aurora's entities relate to each other and which IDs are required at each step, see [Entity Hierarchy](https://docs.aurorasolar.com/docs/entity-hierarchy).

If you need help implementing the APIs, please reach out to the Aurora support team at [developer-support@aurorasolar.com](mailto:developer-support@aurorasolar.com).
